source_roles.EA_NATIVE: Read-only instantaneous in-game motive/buff sensor, exact patch and actual source hook inspection required. Static tuning or save file is NOT instantaneous runtime measurement.
source_roles.HUD_CV: Independently calibrated HUD semantic detection: arrow count 1..3 ordinal, direction and optional calibrated level; NEVER 3x numeric multiplier.

source_health.context_bound_receipts: Carried healthy/recovering source health must bind exact game build, selected Sim, profile, source identity and real producer adapter/calibration; changed context moves to quarantine and requires a distinct reset plus two probes.
source_health.monotonic_sample_timestamps: A changed sample_ref is insufficient. Same or older wall-clock timestamps for an already healthy or recovering producer quarantine that source; failover remains possible.

profiles: Reuse exact CATREADY catalog profile motive keys (Servo: fun social durability charge; human: six needs), no fixed six for nonhuman
native_rate: Only version-pinned read-only EA-native hook with separate proof; number is normalized motive units per Sim minute and unavailable while paused

native_rate_forecast.statement: Source-proven unpaused native level and signed rate can form conditional linear Sim-minute estimate to policy-preemptive level 0.55; when estimate <=30 minutes, early high-priority advisory even while meter green. These are transparent heuristic thresholds, NOT EA tuning or observed chevron 3x.

moodlet_observation_provenance: Supplied moodlet observation must be verified, same selected Sim, exact game build, capture, timestamp within 60 seconds; a prior portrait's happy/bad mood never influences current Servo.
moodlet_positive_activity_gate: Only preserve positive activity if every profile-specific current motive has a verified level >= policy 0.55, no conflict/reobserve requirement, and no rapid decline; unknown or low motive levels produce POSITIVE_MOOD_NEED_SAFETY_UNVERIFIED.
